Guidehouse is seeking a Junior OneStream Developer to support its Defense & Security Segment. The role develops and configures OneStream applications for financial close, reconciliation, and payroll management, while supporting system migrations, enhancements, testing, and compliance-focused financial management.
Professional Services
Consulting
Government
Advice
Management Consulting
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Develop OneStream applications that focus on financial close, financial reconciliation, and payroll management
Configure OneStream cubes, dimensions, workflows, business rules, and forms
Support migration activities related to legacy tool retirement, including data loads, data validation, reconciliation, and parallel comparisons between legacy systems and OneStream
Support the development, testing, and documentation of OneStream business rules and system enhancements
Collaborate with senior developers and business analysts to implement business and technical requirements for OneStream applications that are in alignment with audit readiness and financial management compliance standards
Participate in Agile ceremonies, coordinate personal product backlog with senior developers, and actively participate in iterative development cycles to deliver high-quality solutions

Required
Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, finance, accounting, data analytics, information systems, or a related field
ONE (1) years of relevant OneStream development experience including configuring and supporting OneStream workflows, Cube Views, Business Rules, data integration, dashboards, and reporting solutions
Preferred
Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY
OneStream certification (any level)
Completion of OneStream training programs and demonstrated hands-on experience supporting OneStream applications
Knowledge of federal financial management processes, audit readiness requirements, and compliance standards
Experience with SQL Server
Exposure to API integrations and automation solutions and basic knowledge of ETL tools and data warehousing concepts
Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, PeopleSoft, or Microsoft Dynamics
Exposure to or general understanding of Agile project delivery methodologies
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including client-facing and technical writing
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver under tight timelines with minimal supervision
Experience supporting parallel testing, UAT, and legacy financial data migration efforts
Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, planning, and financial consolidation processes, and general knowledge of GL structures and financial data relationships
